text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe just 
around the corner, I was making final 
adjustments together with Manhattan Cafe—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haa—haa—
choice_data_list: You seem to be in good shape.
You seem to be in good shape.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.... Thank you... very much...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... I just can't see... ...my 
"friends"... anywhere today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Friend." The mysterious entity that only 
Manhattan Cafe can see, whom she has 
always chased after as her goal.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Since coming here... I feel like... the 
times you aren't around... have 
increased... a bit...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No, not that... surely—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I think it's because... next time will be 
different.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
All this time, I've... been running... 
just to catch up to my "friend"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I want to run... like my 'friend'... I 
want to catch up... to my 'friend's' 
back...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But... the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is... 
different...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... ...What I'm aiming for here... 
isn't... my "friend's" back...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is... 
beyond that back... A place to prove... my 
own strength... That is why—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
From here on... run with your own 
strength, you say... Not side by side... 
Keep running... beyond that, huh...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Did you... acknowledge me, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, an exceptionally powerful 
gust of wind blew past from behind—
G o --

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......Heh... Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...She really... fired me up... She told 
me... to make sure I win...--"
choice_data_list:
Let's show them what it means to be the 
"best in the world"!

Let's show everyone what it means to be 
the "best in the world"!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.... ...Without fail...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, pushed forward by a mysterious 
power, Manhattan Cafe set off toward the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—
